intro.title: Card Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Card component in React with TypeScript. You will learn how to structure a component to display information like a title, description, and image in a clean, contained box. The core concept is using React functional components with TypeScript interfaces to define the shape of the component's props. You will work with JSX for the layout and basic CSS for styling, creating a foundational UI element common in web applications.
intro.usecase: Card components are foundational UI patterns used across modern web applications to display grouped information in visually distinct containers. You'll find them in e-commerce product listings, social media feeds showing posts, dashboard widgets displaying metrics, and news/article previews. As a developer, you'll frequently build and customize card components to present content consistently while maintaining clean separation between different information blocks. Mastering card implementation helps create professional, organized interfaces that users encounter daily in platforms like Amazon, Twitter, and analytics dashboards.
